title: Why the Aventador Was the Last of Its Kind

scenes.text: On the twenty-sixth of September twenty twenty-two, Lamborghini announced that the last Aventador had been built, a light-blue Ultimae Roadster for a Swiss buyer. It closed eleven years of production and, in the company's words, the last pure naturally aspirated V12 built at Sant'Agata Bolognese. This is why the Aventador was the last of its kind, and where our sources disagree about how many were built.
scenes.caption: WHY THE AVENTADOR WAS THE LAST OF ITS KIND

scenes.text: Our sources are Lamborghini's own press release, Motor Authority from September twenty twenty-two, Motor1 from July twenty twenty-one, Wikipedia's pages on the Aventador, Murciélago, Huracán and Revuelto, IEEE Spectrum and TechCrunch. They disagree on production totals, end dates and the last car. We show each version. Our own arithmetic is labelled.
scenes.caption: SOURCES: LAMBORGHINI PRESS RELEASE (26 SEP 2022) · MOTOR AUTHORITY (26 SEP 2022) · MOTOR1 (7 JUL 2021) · WIKIPEDIA (AVENTADOR, MURCIÉLAGO, HURACÁN, REVUELTO) · IEEE SPECTRUM · TECHCRUNCH · DISAGREEMENTS SHOWN

scenes.text: The Aventador replaced the Murciélago, which Wikipedia says was built from two thousand one to two thousand ten, ending on the fifth of November two thousand ten. The Murciélago was Lamborghini's first new model under Audi, and used a six point two litre V12 that grew to six point five from the LP 640 in two thousand six.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA (MURCIÉLAGO): PRODUCED 2001–2010, ENDED 5 NOV 2010 · FIRST NEW LAMBORGHINI UNDER AUDI · 6.2 L V12 → 6.5 L FROM LP 640 (2006)

scenes.text: Murciélago production is itself disputed. Wikipedia's text says four thousand ninety-nine cars, while its year-by-year table sums to three thousand nine hundred eighty-three, made up of 3,084 coupés and 899 roadsters. By our arithmetic, the gap is one hundred sixteen cars. The page does not explain which figure is correct.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA (MURCIÉLAGO): TEXT 4,099 vs TABLE 3,983 (3,084 COUPÉS + 899 ROADSTERS) · 4,099 − 3,983 = 116 (OUR ARITHMETIC) · REASON: NOT GIVEN

scenes.text: The Murciélago's final variant, the LP 670-4 SuperVeloce, made six hundred seventy metric horsepower, according to Wikipedia. The Aventador debuted in two thousand eleven at the Geneva motor show with seven hundred. By our arithmetic, the new car raised the V12's output by four and a half percent over the old flagship, while also changing the engine to a new sixty-degree design developed in-house.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA (MURCIÉLAGO): LP 670-4 SV, 670 PS · AVENTADOR LP 700-4, 700 PS, DEBUTED GENEVA 2011 · LAMBORGHINI PRESS RELEASE: NEW 60° V12 DEVELOPED IN-HOUSE · 700 ÷ 670 = +4.5% (OUR ARITHMETIC)

scenes.text: Lamborghini's twenty twenty-two press release says the Aventador debuted in two thousand eleven as the LP seven hundred-4. It calls the car the flagship model for eleven years of production. Chairman and chief executive Stephan Winkelmann said it was a game-changer at its launch. Motor1 spells the first name Stephen, and we use the press release's spelling.
scenes.caption: LAMBORGHINI (26 SEP 2022): AVENTADOR DEBUTED 2011 AS LP 700-4; 'FLAGSHIP MODEL FOR 11 YEARS OF PRODUCTION'; STEPHAN WINKELMANN, CHAIRMAN AND CEO · MOTOR1 SPELLS 'STEPHEN' · WE FOLLOW THE PRESS RELEASE

scenes.text: Motor Authority says the Aventador had eight variants, not counting low-volume specials. Wikipedia lists the LP 700-4, the Roadster, the S, the SV, the SVJ, the Ultimae and several one-offs. By our arithmetic, power rose from seven hundred to seven hundred eighty metric horsepower over the run, an increase of eleven percent, in about ten years.
scenes.caption: MOTOR AUTHORITY: 8 VARIANTS (EXCLUDING LOW-VOLUME SPECIALS) · WIKIPEDIA: LP 700-4 700 PS → ULTIMAE 780 PS · +11.4% (OUR ARITHMETIC) · 2011 → 2021 = 10 YEARS

scenes.text: The sequence, as Wikipedia gives it: the S in twenty seventeen with seven forty and four-wheel steering, the SV at seven fifty, the SVJ at seven seventy, unveiled at Pebble Beach in twenty eighteen, and the Ultimae at seven eighty in twenty twenty-one. Each was a limited or higher-priced step on the same engine, which Wikipedia says weighs about two hundred thirty-five kilograms.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: S (2017) 740 PS, 4-WHEEL STEERING · SV 750 PS · SVJ (PEBBLE BEACH 2018) 770 PS · ULTIMAE (2021) 780 PS · ENGINE ~235 KG

scenes.text: Production numbers show the cars' success. Wikipedia says the Aventador was originally planned for four thousand units and that the five-thousandth was built by March twenty sixteen. Total production, it says, was eleven thousand eight hundred thirty-one, with a peak of twelve hundred eighty-six in twenty seventeen. Motor Authority says eleven thousand four hundred sixty-five sold worldwide.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: PLANNED 4,000 · 5,000th BUILT BY MARCH 2016 · TOTAL BUILT 11,831 · PEAK 1,286 (2017) · MOTOR AUTHORITY (26 SEP 2022): 11,465 SOLD WORLDWIDE

scenes.text: By our arithmetic, Wikipedia's total is three hundred sixty-six cars higher than Motor Authority's, a difference of three percent. One is a production count and the other a sales figure, which could explain a gap, but neither source says so. Against the Murciélago's disputed four thousand ninety-nine, the Aventador sold between two point eight and three point oh times as many.
scenes.caption: 11,831 − 11,465 = 366 (3.1%) · 11,465 ÷ 4,099 = 2.8× · 11,831 ÷ 3,983 = 3.0× (OUR ARITHMETIC) · 'PRODUCTION vs SALES' = OUR EXPLANATION, NOT STATED BY EITHER SOURCE

scenes.text: Lamborghini's press release says more Aventadors were sold than all previous V12 models combined, and Motor Authority repeats it. Our sources do not give totals for the older V12 cars other than the Murciélago, so we cannot check the claim ourselves. We report it as Lamborghini's statement, and we have no independent figure that disproves it.
scenes.caption: LAMBORGHINI + MOTOR AUTHORITY: AVENTADOR SOLD MORE THAN ALL PREVIOUS V12 MODELS COMBINED · TOTALS FOR OTHER V12 MODELS: NOT IN OUR SOURCES (ONLY MURCIÉLAGO) → UNVERIFIED

scenes.text: The Ultimae was announced in July twenty twenty-one. Motor1, quoting Lamborghini, called it the last naturally aspirated Lamborghini V12, with seven hundred sixty-nine horsepower at eighty-five hundred revs, the most powerful naturally aspirated twelve-cylinder ever built at Sant'Agata Bolognese. The press release called it the grand finale of the traditional V12 combustion engine.
scenes.caption: MOTOR1 (7 JUL 2021): ULTIMAE = LAST NATURALLY ASPIRATED LAMBORGHINI V12 (PER LAMBORGHINI); 769 HP @ 8,500; MOST POWERFUL NA 12-CYLINDER BUILT AT SANT'AGATA · PRESS RELEASE: 'GRAND FINALE OF THE TRADITIONAL V12 COMBUSTION ENGINE'

scenes.text: Winkelmann called it the final, purest, timeless naturally aspirated production V12 Lamborghini, and said it was the last of its kind. The wording is precise. Motor1's author noted that it says traditional and naturally aspirated, leaving room for future V12s, which is what happened. The author's reading was analysis, not a Lamborghini confirmation.
scenes.caption: MOTOR1: WINKELMANN — 'THE FINAL, PUREST, TIMELESS NATURALLY-ASPIRATED PRODUCTION V12 LAMBORGHINI'; 'THE LAST OF ITS KIND' · AUTHOR'S ANALYSIS: WORDING ('TRADITIONAL', 'NATURALLY-ASPIRATED') LEAVES ROOM FOR FUTURE V12s (ANALYSIS, NOT LAMBORGHINI CONFIRMATION)

scenes.text: The Ultimae was limited to six hundred cars, three hundred fifty coupés and two hundred fifty roadsters, per Wikipedia and Motor Authority. Motor Authority adds that the end date was pushed back after some examples were lost when the cargo ship Felicity Ace sank in February twenty twenty-two. Wikipedia says a fire destroyed fifteen cars on that ship, and Lamborghini restarted Ultimae production.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA + MOTOR AUTHORITY: ULTIMAE 350 COUPÉS + 250 ROADSTERS · MOTOR AUTHORITY: END DATE PUSHED BACK AFTER EXAMPLES LOST WHEN FELICITY ACE SANK (FEB 2022) · WIKIPEDIA: FIRE DESTROYED 15 CARS; PRODUCTION RESTARTED · SANK vs FIRE: BOTH APPEAR IN OUR SOURCES (A FIRE ON THE SHIP CAN PRECEDE A SINKING — OUR INFERENCE, NOT STATED)

scenes.text: The last car is described differently. Lamborghini's press release and Motor Authority say it was an Ultimae Roadster, in a custom light blue chosen by its Swiss buyer. Wikipedia says the last car, built in July twenty twenty-two, was an Ultimae styled as a homage to a nineteen sixty-eight Miura P four hundred, and gives September as the end of production in its infobox.
scenes.caption: PRESS RELEASE + MOTOR AUTHORITY: LAST CAR = ULTIMAE ROADSTER, CUSTOM LIGHT BLUE, SWISS BUYER, ANNOUNCED 26 SEP 2022 · WIKIPEDIA: LAST CAR JULY 2022, ULTIMAE HOMAGE TO A 1968 MIURA P400; INFOBOX END SEPT 2022 → CONFLICT (POSSIBLY DIFFERENT 'LAST' CARS — NOT STATED)

scenes.text: By our arithmetic, the two dates give a gap of about two months, July to the week before the twenty-sixth of September. They might describe different cars, such as the last coupé and the last roadster, but our sources do not say that. We also cannot say whether the Miura homage was the last coupé or a one-off, so we keep both accounts.
scenes.caption: JULY 2022 → ~19 SEP 2022 ≈ 2 MONTHS (OUR ARITHMETIC; MOTOR AUTHORITY: ENDED 'THE WEEK BEFORE' 26 SEP) · 'DIFFERENT CARS' = OUR SPECULATION

scenes.text: The last Ultimae coupé sold for over one point six million dollars at RM Sotheby's in April twenty twenty-two, with a one-of-one digital token, Wikipedia says. By our arithmetic, that is three point one times the SVJ coupé's base price of five hundred seventeen thousand seven hundred seventy dollars from IEEE, and the sale came five months before the line closed.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: LAST ULTIMAE COUPÉ > $1.6 M, RM SOTHEBY'S, APRIL 2022, WITH A 1-OF-1 NFT · IEEE: SVJ BASE $517,770 · $1.6 M ÷ $517,770 = 3.1× (OUR ARITHMETIC) · APRIL → SEPT 2022 = 5 MONTHS

scenes.text: The replacement was the Revuelto, unveiled on the twenty-ninth of March twenty twenty-three in an online event, Wikipedia says. It keeps a naturally aspirated six point five litre V12 rated at eight hundred twenty-five metric horsepower at ninety-two fifty revs, but adds three electric motors with one hundred ninety metric horsepower, for a combined one thousand fifteen.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: REVUELTO UNVEILED 29 MAR 2023 (ONLINE); 6.5 L NA V12, 825 PS (814 HP) @ 9,250 RPM; 3 ELECTRIC MOTORS 190 PS (187 HP); TOTAL 1,015 PS (1,001 HP)

scenes.text: By our arithmetic, the Revuelto's total output is thirty percent higher than the Ultimae's seven hundred eighty. Its V12 alone makes six percent more than the Ultimae's, and the electric motors add the rest. Zero to one hundred takes two point five seconds, per Wikipedia, against two point eight four for the Ultimae. Top speed is the same three hundred fifty.
scenes.caption: 1,015 ÷ 780 = +30.1% · 825 ÷ 780 = +5.8% (OUR ARITHMETIC) · WIKIPEDIA: REVUELTO 0–100 2.5 S, 350 KM/H · ULTIMAE 2.84 S, 354 KM/H · 2.84 − 2.5 = 0.34 S (OUR ARITHMETIC)

scenes.text: It is heavier. Wikipedia lists the Revuelto at seventeen seventy-two kilograms dry and eighteen eighty kerb, with a three point eight kilowatt-hour battery and an electric range of ten kilometres. The Ultimae is fifteen fifty. By our arithmetic, the Revuelto is two hundred twenty-two kilograms heavier on those numbers, fourteen percent more, though the two figures may not use the same basis.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: REVUELTO 1,772 KG DRY; 1,880 KG KERB; 3.8 KWH; ELECTRIC RANGE 10 KM · ULTIMAE 1,550 KG · 1,772 − 1,550 = 222 KG (+14.3%) (OUR ARITHMETIC; DRY vs UNSPECIFIED BASIS)

scenes.text: Wikipedia also says the Revuelto's carbon-fibre monocoque is ten percent lighter than the Aventador's chassis, with torsional rigidity improved by twenty-five percent. It is the brand's first plug-in hybrid. First deliveries were in the last quarter of twenty twenty-three, and one thousand four hundred six were produced in twenty twenty-four. The page leaves the twenty twenty-five figure blank.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: REVUELTO — CARBON MONOCOQUE 10% LIGHTER THAN AVENTADOR'S, +25% TORSIONAL RIGIDITY · FIRST PLUG-IN HYBRID · DELIVERIES FROM Q4 2023 · 1,406 PRODUCED IN 2024 · 2025: BLANK

scenes.text: The Revuelto page has internal conflicts: total torque is seven hundred eighty-three pound-feet in one section and five ninety-five in another, and electric motor torque differs as well. Its price is not stated. So where the Aventador's price is well documented, the successor's is not in our sources. We will not guess it.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA (REVUELTO): TOTAL TORQUE 783 LB-FT (1,062 N·M) vs 595 LB-FT (807 N·M) · ELECTRIC TORQUE 248 LB-FT vs 60 LB-FT · 'THREE MOTORS' vs 'FRONT E-AXLE' · PRICE: NOT STATED

scenes.text: By our arithmetic from Wikipedia's 2024 figure, the Revuelto built one thousand four hundred six cars in a year. The Aventador's best year was twelve hundred eighty-six, in twenty seventeen. So the hybrid successor out-produced its predecessor's peak by nine percent in its first full year, on these numbers, though Wikipedia's page gives no 2023 figure.
scenes.caption: REVUELTO 1,406 (2024) vs AVENTADOR PEAK 1,286 (2017) · +9.3% (OUR ARITHMETIC) · REVUELTO 2023 FIGURE: NOT GIVEN

scenes.text: The reason the Aventador was last is electrification. Motor Authority says Lamborghini said it will not build any more V12 models without electrification, at least for road use, and that every Lamborghini would use some form of electrification as early as twenty twenty-four. It also says the replacement would be only the third V12 in Lamborghini's history.
scenes.caption: MOTOR AUTHORITY (26 SEP 2022): NO MORE V12 ROAD MODELS WITHOUT ELECTRIFICATION; EVERY LAMBORGHINI ELECTRIFIED BY AS EARLY AS 2024; REPLACEMENT = ONLY THE 3RD V12 IN LAMBORGHINI'S HISTORY

scenes.text: IEEE Spectrum said as early as twenty nineteen that Lamborghini was developing a gas-electric V12 hybrid successor. TechCrunch in twenty twenty-one quotes the chief executive saying the Huracán would be hybridised by twenty twenty-four and that the existing combustion versions would be discontinued. So the plan was visible years before the last Aventador was built.
scenes.caption: IEEE SPECTRUM (2019): HYBRID V12 SUCCESSOR BEING DEVELOPED · TECHCRUNCH (23 SEP 2021): HURACÁN HYBRIDISED BY 2024, COMBUSTION VERSIONS DISCONTINUED · 2019 → 2022 = 3 YEARS (OUR ARITHMETIC)

scenes.text: Wikipedia says the Huracán ended in twenty twenty-four, with the Temerario named as its successor, and describes the Sterrato as the last non-hybrid model Lamborghini would launch. By our arithmetic, the V12 flagship's pure combustion run ended in twenty twenty-two and the V10's about two years later, in step with the stated plan.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: HURACÁN 2014–2024; TEMERARIO = SUCCESSOR; STERRATO = LAST NON-HYBRID MODEL LAMBORGHINI WOULD LAUNCH · AVENTADOR 2022 → HURACÁN 2024 = 2 YEARS (OUR ARITHMETIC)

scenes.text: The STO was a celebration of the combustion engine, TechCrunch quotes Lamborghini's chief executive. The Ultimae was the grand finale of the V12. Both were framed as farewells before they were. By our arithmetic, the STO came out in twenty twenty-one, the Ultimae the same year, and the last of each line ended within three years of the farewell announcements.
scenes.caption: TECHCRUNCH: STO = 'A CELEBRATION OF THE COMBUSTION ENGINE' · MOTOR1 + PRESS RELEASE: ULTIMAE = 'GRAND FINALE OF THE TRADITIONAL V12' · ANNOUNCED 2021; LINES ENDED 2022 (AVENTADOR) AND 2024 (HURACÁN) (OUR ARITHMETIC)

scenes.text: Motor Authority also says Lamborghini planned an electric fourth model line, expected to be a grand tourer launching in the second half of the decade. That is a plan reported in September twenty twenty-two, and our sources do not tell us whether it is still on schedule. We include it for context, not as a prediction.
scenes.caption: MOTOR AUTHORITY (26 SEP 2022): EV FOURTH MODEL LINE PLANNED, EXPECTED TO BE A GRAND TOURER IN 2H OF THE DECADE · CURRENT STATUS: NOT IN OUR SOURCES

scenes.text: So what does it mean to be the last of its kind? Strictly, the last Lamborghini V12 road car with no electrification. The Revuelto still has a naturally aspirated V12, but with electric motors. In terms of numbers, it is a car with the same displacement, more power, more weight and a different philosophy. Whether that is better is not something our sources decide.
scenes.caption: SYNTHESIS FROM LAMBORGHINI, MOTOR1, MOTOR AUTHORITY, WIKIPEDIA · REVUELTO: SAME 6.5 L NA V12 BASE, +ELECTRIFICATION · 'BETTER OR NOT' = NOT DECIDED BY OUR SOURCES

scenes.text: There is a collector angle too. Wikipedia's last-Ultimae sale at over one point six million dollars, and the used SVJ Roadster listed at nine hundred seventy-five thousand by Lambocars, suggest that final-edition cars attract premiums. But we have no data on how the whole Aventador market behaved, and the unsourced Automonitor page is the only one with a time series, which we flag as weak.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: LAST ULTIMAE COUPÉ > $1.6 M · LAMBOCARS: 2020 SVJ ROADSTER LISTED $975,000 · AUTOMONITOR (UNSOURCED): COUPÉ AVERAGE $530K (2020) → $660K (2025 EST.) · MARKET-WIDE DATA: NOT IN OUR SOURCES

scenes.text: One more number, our own. Eleven years from two thousand eleven to two thousand twenty-two is the Aventador's life, per Lamborghini. The Murciélago ran nine years and ten months, from two thousand one to November two thousand ten, per Wikipedia. By our arithmetic, the Aventador's run was about twelve percent longer than the Murciélago's, and it sold roughly three times as many cars.
scenes.caption: AVENTADOR 2011 → 2022 = 11 YEARS (LAMBORGHINI) · MURCIÉLAGO 2001 → 5 NOV 2010 ≈ 9.8 YEARS (WIKIPEDIA) · 11 ÷ 9.8 = +12% (OUR ARITHMETIC) · 2.8–3.0× UNITS

scenes.text: Wikipedia's year-by-year table for the Murciélago, from two thousand one to two thousand ten, reads sixty-five, four forty-two, four twenty-four, three eighty-four, four sixty-four, four forty-four, six twenty-nine, six thirty-seven, three thirty-one and one sixty-three. Its best year was two thousand eight, with six hundred thirty-seven cars.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA (MURCIÉLAGO) TABLE: 2001 65 · 2002 442 · 2003 424 · 2004 384 · 2005 464 · 2006 444 · 2007 629 · 2008 637 · 2009 331 · 2010 163 → SUM 3,983 (OUR ARITHMETIC CHECK)
scenes.chapter: Comparing the two eras in numbers

scenes.text: By our arithmetic, the Aventador's best year, twelve hundred eighty-six cars in twenty seventeen, was double the Murciélago's best. The Aventador's totals of around eleven and a half thousand cars over eleven and a half years average about one thousand a year, against the Murciélago's roughly four hundred a year. The Aventador sold at roughly two and a half times the pace.
scenes.caption: 1,286 ÷ 637 = 2.02× · 11,831 ÷ 11.5 = 1,029/YR · 3,983 ÷ 9.8 = 406/YR (OUR ARITHMETIC; APPROXIMATE SPANS: AVENTADOR FEB 2011 → SEPT 2022; MURCIÉLAGO 2001 → NOV 2010) · RATIO 2.5×

scenes.text: A caution on the average. The Aventador's yearly deliveries were not flat: the five-thousandth car was built by March twenty sixteen, about five years in, which by our arithmetic is about a thousand a year at first, and the peak of twelve eighty-six came later in twenty seventeen. Wikipedia gives no full yearly breakdown in the passages we used.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: 5,000th BY MARCH 2016; PEAK 1,286 IN 2017 · FEB 2011 → MAR 2016 ≈ 5.1 YR → ~980/YR (OUR ARITHMETIC) · FULL YEARLY TABLE: NOT IN THE PASSAGES WE USED (DELIVERIES 798 IN 2021 AND 753 IN 2022 ARE QUOTED)

scenes.text: The last two years, by Wikipedia's table, were seven hundred ninety-eight in twenty twenty-one and seven hundred fifty-three in twenty twenty-two. By our arithmetic, the final two years together, at fifteen hundred fifty-one, were thirteen percent of the car's lifetime total of eleven thousand eight hundred thirty-one. Many of those were Ultimae cars, though the table does not split them.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: 798 (2021) + 753 (2022) = 1,551 · 1,551 ÷ 11,831 = 13.1% (OUR ARITHMETIC) · ULTIMAE SHARE OF THOSE: NOT SPLIT IN OUR SOURCES

scenes.text: Prices stretch across the story. Wikipedia lists the Veneno at four million dollars at the twenty thirteen Geneva show, the Aventador J concept selling for two point eight million, and a one-eighth-scale model starting its bid at four point seven million dollars. By our arithmetic, that model's opening bid was nearly three times the price of the last Ultimae coupé, a scale model costing more than a real car.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: VENENO (2013 GENEVA) $4,000,000 · AVENTADOR J CONCEPT SOLD $2.8 M · GÜLPEN 1/8-SCALE MODEL STARTING BID $4.7 M · $4.7 M ÷ $1.6 M = 2.9× (OUR ARITHMETIC; STARTING BID, NOT A SALE)

scenes.text: Strictly, the Veneno and the J are not Aventador production cars, but Wikipedia places them in the Aventador family. We mention them as the top of the price scale rather than part of the normal range. The normal range, per our other sources, runs from the SVJ's five hundred seventeen thousand seven hundred seventy dollars new to nine hundred seventy-five thousand used.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA PLACES VENENO / J IN THE AVENTADOR FAMILY · IEEE: SVJ BASE $517,770 · LAMBOCARS: 2020 SVJ ROADSTER USED LISTING $975,000

scenes.text: The engine is central. Wikipedia describes the Aventador's L539 as a six thousand four hundred ninety-eight cubic centimetre sixty-degree V12 weighing about two hundred thirty-five kilograms. Lamborghini calls the Aventador's V12 new in two thousand eleven, developed in-house. Motor Authority says the Revuelto's engine is newly developed too, only the third V12 in Lamborghini's history.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: AVENTADOR L539 6,498 CC 60° V12, ~235 KG · LAMBORGHINI: NEW IN-HOUSE V12 IN 2011 · MOTOR AUTHORITY: REVUELTO ENGINE = 3RD V12 IN LAMBORGHINI'S HISTORY

scenes.text: Wikipedia gives the Revuelto the same displacement, six thousand four hundred ninety-eight cubic centimetres, as the Aventador. By our arithmetic, the Revuelto's V12 alone makes one hundred twenty-five horsepower per litre, against one hundred eighteen for the Ultimae's seven hundred sixty-nine horsepower from the same capacity. The newer engine revs to ninety-two fifty against eighty-five hundred.
scenes.caption: REVUELTO V12 814 HP @ 9,250 RPM · ULTIMAE 769 HP @ 8,500 RPM · 6.498 L BOTH · 814 ÷ 6.498 = 125.3 HP/L; 769 ÷ 6.498 = 118.3 HP/L (OUR ARITHMETIC; WIKIPEDIA + MOTOR1 FIGURES)

scenes.text: So the combustion engine itself kept improving to the end. Wikipedia's figures show the V12 gaining about six percent in power between the Ultimae and the Revuelto, from seven sixty-nine horsepower to eight fourteen. The difference is that the Revuelto adds electric motors and a battery on top, and a heavier body. The V12 did not stop being developed, it stopped being alone.
scenes.caption: 769 → 814 HP = +5.9% (OUR ARITHMETIC) · REVUELTO ADDS 3 ELECTRIC MOTORS, 3.8 KWH BATTERY, HEAVIER (1,772 KG DRY) (WIKIPEDIA) · 'STOPPED BEING ALONE' = OUR PHRASING

scenes.text: The Revuelto's transmission is an eight-speed dual-clutch with all-wheel drive, Wikipedia says. The Aventador's was a seven-speed single-clutch automated manual that Autocar criticised in its SVJ test. So the biggest change a driver would notice, by our reading, is the gearbox, not the engine. The sources do not compare the two cars on the road, so this is our inference.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: REVUELTO 8-SPEED DUAL-CLUTCH, AWD · AVENTADOR 7-SPEED SINGLE-CLUTCH ISR · AUTOCAR (SVJ): GEARBOX CRITICISED · 'BIGGEST CHANGE A DRIVER WOULD NOTICE' = OUR INFERENCE; NO ROAD COMPARISON IN OUR SOURCES

scenes.text: Performance: the Revuelto's zero to two hundred takes six point six seconds, and zero to three hundred fifteen point three, per Wikipedia. The Aventador SVJ takes eight point six to two hundred. By our arithmetic, the Revuelto is two seconds faster to two hundred, twenty-three percent quicker. That is the clearest measurable gain from electrification in our sources.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: REVUELTO 0–200 KM/H 6.6 S; 0–300 15.3 S · SVJ 0–200 8.6 S · 8.6 − 6.6 = 2.0 S; 2.0 ÷ 8.6 = 23.3% (OUR ARITHMETIC; CLAIMED FIGURES)

scenes.text: For owners, the end of the line matters. The Garage Intelligence newsletter in March twenty twenty-six estimates the yearly running cost of a twenty thirteen Aventador at thirty-four to forty-six thousand dollars, and the example car sold at three hundred seven thousand. By our arithmetic, that is eleven to fifteen percent of its price every year, a bill that does not depend on whether the model is still in production.
scenes.caption: GARAGE INTELLIGENCE (4 MAR 2026): 2013 AVENTADOR SOLD $307,000; ~$34.3–46.3K/YR TO RUN · $34,300 ÷ $307,000 = 11.2%; $46,300 ÷ $307,000 = 15.1% (OUR ARITHMETIC) · 'DOES NOT DEPEND ON PRODUCTION' = OUR OBSERVATION

scenes.text: Lambocars, citing CarEdge, says an Aventador loses up to thirty-one percent over five years, while the Huracán loses forty-six. Whether the end of production changes that is not covered in our sources. The unsourced Automonitor table suggests the SVJ coupé's average value rose from five hundred thirty thousand in twenty twenty to six hundred sixty thousand in a twenty twenty-five estimate. We flag it as weak.
scenes.caption: LAMBOCARS (CITING CAREDGE): AVENTADOR UP TO −31% / 5 YR; HURACÁN −46% · AUTOMONITOR (UNSOURCED): SVJ COUPÉ $530K (2020) → $660K (2025 EST.) · EFFECT OF END OF PRODUCTION: NOT IN OUR SOURCES

scenes.text: The Huracán tells a parallel story. TechCrunch says Huracán sales since its twenty fourteen launch reached seventeen thousand five hundred by September twenty twenty-one. Wikipedia's yearly table sums to about twenty-nine thousand seven hundred ninety-five by twenty twenty-four. By our arithmetic, the Huracán sold two and a half times as many cars as the Aventador over its life, in about the same number of years.
scenes.caption: TECHCRUNCH (SEP 2021): 17,500 HURACÁNS SINCE 2014 · WIKIPEDIA TABLE: ~29,795 (2014–2024) · 29,795 ÷ 11,831 = 2.5× (OUR ARITHMETIC; HURACÁN 2014–2024 = 10–11 YEARS vs AVENTADOR 2011–2022 = 11 YEARS)

scenes.text: Together, by our arithmetic from Wikipedia's totals, the two lines built more than forty-one thousand cars. Both ended their purely combustion lives within two years of each other: the Aventador in September twenty twenty-two and the Huracán in twenty twenty-four. For a brand that once built a few hundred cars a year, these are very large numbers.
scenes.caption: 11,831 + 29,795 = 41,626 (OUR ARITHMETIC; WIKIPEDIA TOTALS) · AVENTADOR ENDED SEPT 2022; HURACÁN 2024 · 'ONCE BUILT A FEW HUNDRED A YEAR' = OUR REFERENCE TO THE MURCIÉLAGO TABLE (≈ 400/YR)

scenes.text: Lamborghini's farewell language was consistent across both. The Ultimae was the last of its kind, the STO a celebration of combustion. And the Sterrato, Wikipedia says, was the last non-hybrid model Lamborghini would launch, with one thousand four hundred ninety-nine built in twenty twenty-three and twenty twenty-four. By our arithmetic, that is two and a half times the Ultimae's six hundred cars, and eighty-two percent of the SVJ family's eighteen hundred twenty-six.
scenes.caption: WIKIPEDIA: STERRATO 1,499 BUILT 2023–2024; LAST NON-HYBRID MODEL TO LAUNCH · 1,499 ÷ 600 = 2.5× ULTIMAE (OUR ARITHMETIC) · 1,499 ÷ 1,826 = 82.1% (OUR ARITHMETIC; ASSUMES 1,826)

scenes.text: So the Aventador was the last of its kind in a precise sense and an incomplete one. Precise, because Lamborghini itself said so, naming the Ultimae the last naturally aspirated V12 in a pure combustion car. Incomplete, because the next V12 is still naturally aspirated, only with electric motors beside it. The label depends on how much weight you give the word pure.
scenes.caption: LAMBORGHINI: 'LAST PURE, NATURALLY ASPIRATED V12' · WIKIPEDIA: REVUELTO = NA V12 + 3 ELECTRIC MOTORS · 'HOW MUCH WEIGHT TO GIVE PURE' = OUR EDITORIAL POINT

scenes.text: What is missing. A reconciled production total, eleven thousand four hundred sixty-five or eleven thousand eight hundred thirty-one. A reconciled last car and end date. A figure for the older V12 models, to test the claim that the Aventador outsold them all. The Revuelto's price and its order book. And whether the Ultimae's six hundred cars were all delivered. If you have a primary document, put it in the comments.
scenes.caption: NOT IN OUR SOURCES: RECONCILED TOTAL (11,465 vs 11,831) · RECONCILED LAST CAR AND DATE · OLDER-V12 TOTALS · REVUELTO PRICE / ORDER BOOK · ULTIMAE DELIVERY COUNT
scenes.chapter: What the sources do not say

scenes.text: So the Aventador was the last of its kind because Lamborghini decided its V12 would be electrified from then on, and the Ultimae was built as the farewell. Its numbers are still disputed, even for the final car. In the other videos this week, we reveal the SVJ's lesser-known facts, compare it with the Huracán STO, and count what it costs to own.
